title: build discard <id> deletes one draft, --all deletes every draft file and keeps the folder's .gitignore; a bad id or argument is rejected before anything is deleted
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `discard <id>` removes `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml` and prints `discarded <id>`; an id with no draft is `JITSO REJECTED: no draft "<id>"`; an id that is not kebab-case (a path, for example) is `JITSO REJECTED: build id must be kebab-case` and never touches the file system; no argument is `JITSO REJECTED: build discard needs a draft id or --all`; a second word is an unknown argument and deletes nothing. `--all` removes every `*.yaml` of the folder and prints `discarded <n> drafts` (0 included), leaving the `.gitignore` and any other file. Discard needs only the project, not the catalog.
